about: The studio's video categories (vinari.ge/studio), the single source of their ids. The site keeps a copy of the id list (web/api/studio.js CATEGORIES, web/studio.html CATS, scripts/studio-dev.mjs) and shows the labels, which are the app's own names for its features (the owner, 2026-10-06: "name them as in the app, I cannot tell what is what"); tools/ci/prompt.mjs puts one category's facts, screens and earlier videos into the brief; tools/build-index.mjs checks a spec's "category". Facts are short English, true to the app (Marketing/VINARI — app brief.md, docs/pricing.md, the store texts and the release notes of each update in VINARI_STATE.md, all in the main Vinari repo): the cloud may use nothing outside them. After every big app update the facts are brought up to date here and in the "whatsnew" category, and the site's copy in step. Order matters: the site lists the categories in this order (the owner, 2026-10-06 evening: the extra categories on top, the new crazy stories first, so he does not scroll down to them): crazy stories, the free idea (the owner, 2026-10-06: right after the stories), car knowledge, general and the announcement, then the app's features in the owner's order of the same morning (QR card, parking, VIN scanner, diagnostics, OBD scanner, navigator, calendar, then the other features). The dice breaks a tie by it, a feature before the rest (as before the move). "feature": false = not one feature (a general video may not list it among the features it shows). "dice": false = the dice (no category, no topic) never rolls it: it is asked for on purpose. "needsTopic": true = made only from a typed idea (the free idea, the owner 2026-10-06: "the video follows MY idea"): the site refuses it empty (web/api/studio.js NEEDS_TOPIC, 400 "topic"), prompt.mjs stops without one (exit 2), it has "dice": false and no "words" (never rolled, never read from a topic), its film follows his lines, and its only screens are those of the features his words name (request.json "freeScreens", tools/ci/prompt.mjs; check.mjs FREE_SCREEN). "openers": the opening families that rotate (the aura family, H21 grindset and H22 heartbreak glow-up, the owner 2026-10-06: every other film of its "home" category, never two films in a row on the page with the same formula, a new put-down against the page's last "fresh" aura openings; tools/ci/prompt.mjs and --record). "diceEvery": n = the dice gives this category every n-th roll (2: every other dice film; the ledger's "from": "dice" counts the rolls): it is due when none of its last n - 1 rolls gave it; when two are due, the more frequent one (the smaller n) takes the roll and the other the next one, so carinfo (2) keeps every other roll and stories (4) takes every fourth (stories, carinfo, a feature, carinfo, stories ...); the other rolls take the least-used category among the rest. "lesson": {"min": s, "length": s} (car knowledge, the owner 2026-10-12: explainer reels "from 45 s to 1 minute", explained step by step, one connected voice) = a NEW film of this category asked shorter than "min" (the site's default 20 s, or the dice landing on it) is made at "length" (tools/ci/prompt.mjs: request.json "length" the film's, "lengthAsked" the site's); a redo of a lesson keeps at least "min"; the site picks "length" itself when the category is chosen. "explain": what the owner wants every viewer of the feature to understand (2026-10-12: "explain simply and concretely"), in his words; the brief puts it in the feature film's step 1 and the film says at least one of them plainly, on its real screen. "tipEvery": n (a bank category) = when none of the category's last n - 1 films used a practical tip (a bank fact with "tip": true), the dice's offer is tips only, so about every n-th car-knowledge film is a reel-style tip that opens on a question (the owner, 2026-10-06); a typed idea or a redo decides for itself. "allfacts": true = the brief also sends the cloud to the categories file for the facts of the features the film shows. "words": case-insensitive patterns that read the category from a topic typed without one (the longest total match wins; general only when nothing else matches; a "bank" category never when the topic names the app, and a tie between it and a feature goes to the feature). "signature": the scene types whose first scene may not repeat the staging of the category's last 2 films (tools/ci/visual.mjs; empty = every staged type). "bank" on stories names its own bank of whole stories (ci/stories-sources.json, tools/ci/stories.mjs: a film tells one story, records it as --story, and the brief offers a few). "bank" on carinfo: the category is general car knowledge from a sourced fact bank ("carinfo", the owner 2026-10-05): its facts are not here but in the file named (ci/carinfo-sources.json: "lines", one "<id>: <plain Georgian>" each, and by id each fact's source, theme, app link, tip flag and real sounds), so this file stays short for the briefs that read it whole; the brief offers a few themes per film, not the whole bank, and --record --facts stores which facts a film used. The App Store gate (the owner, 2026-10-06: the navigator and the OBD scanner are shown faded and refused until the update is public): "release": "1.0.4" = the category is locked until the App Store's live version ("store".lookup, Apple's public lookup, results[0].version) is at least that, compared part by part (1.0.10 > 1.0.4); a lookup that fails keeps it locked. "after": {"<version>": {...}} = from that live version on, the keys it names replace the category's own (facts, never, screens, tier ...): what becomes true at the release (the engine's "the app does not plug into the car", whatsnew's new content, and the screens: vin, widgets, docs and general show the 1.0.4 home 23-home-104 and menu 25-menu-104 instead of 01-home and 10-features, the 1.0.3 home with the old bottom bar and the old menu, which stay until then because 1.0.3 is what people have). Nothing is deployed when Apple releases: tools/ci/release.mjs asks Apple for the dice and the brief, web/api/studio.js for the site (cached "store".minutes), and both flip by themselves. The brief never sends Claude here: prompt.mjs writes out/ci/categories.now.json, this file with the gate applied (locked and retired categories gone, "after" merged), and the brief names that file. "storeScreen" (the owner, 2026-10-14: show now and then that VINARI is on the store, so people know): "src" is the real App Store page of VINARI in public/screens (a 585 px capture scaled to 1080 x 2346, 2 px trimmed a side), never a feature screen and in no category's "screens"; tools/ci/prompt.mjs offers it in the brief when the film may show the app (never car knowledge or a story; a free film only when his words match "words": the app itself or getting it, request.json "freeScreens") and none of the page's last "gap" films showed it (request.json "storeScreen"); check.mjs (VS_CI=1) refuses it in a film the brief did not offer it to, in more than one scene, and a tap or a highlight on the store's Get button ("get", fractions of the capture): it is never a call to action, and the no-store-name rule of the voice and the text stays. "retired": categories taken out of the studio (id: its old label): no new film is made in them, but old films keep the id (specs and the ledger are history), build-index still takes it and the site still shows the old label (price, customs and chart: the owner, 2026-10-06, "rubbish, make it simpler"; honest: 2026-09-28).

categories.label: გიჟური ისტორიები
categories.tier: no app: a true car story with a twist, told for its own sake (the EndCard closes it as always)
facts: The stories are the bank in ci/stories-sources.json: 60 true stories of car history (people who survived, raced, invented or built something, brands that began as something else, records, mysteries), each with its English facts and their source pages, a draft in plain Georgian, its twist, a legend marked where there is one, and its own licensed photos (public/photos, credited). The brief offers a few stories per film; for one it lacks, Grep that file's "lines" ("<id>: <title>. <twist>") for the topic's words, never read it whole, and use only that story's entry.
never: a fact, number, year, place, title, quote or motive that the story's facts do not state (its Georgian drafts are wording, never more facts), or a "first", "biggest", "everyone" or "legendary" no fact says
a legend said as fact: a story with a "legend" says it the way its entry shows (ამბობენ, თვითონ ასე ჰყვებოდა, ლენდროვერის თქმით), and the twist itself is a hard fact
two stories in one film
the app, its name or a screen (the follow line excepted)
a photo that is not the story's own, or a small one full bleed
a joke about an injury, a death or a crash, crash footage, or a scandal, a crime or politics beyond what the facts say
a brand, a person or a country put down (a rivalry is told as a race), or a logo as the subject of a frame

facts: A film that follows the co-founder's own idea: his message, his order and his lines, said like a friend (the buddy tone), with pictures that fit. It talks to the page's audience: cars, driving, Vinari, the page's films, what is coming.

The app's features only as his idea names them, each with its own category's facts, tier, never-list and screens (in the categories file the brief names). Naming the brand alone shows the brand (the mark, the wordmark, the EndCard), never a feature screen.
A teaser is his own vague words ("მალე გიჟურ რამეს ვამატებთ"): said as he said it, nothing added.
His own numbers about the page or its films are said only as he typed them; nothing about the app's users.
never: a feature list read out like an ad
a feature, plan, price, date, version or promise that is neither in the categories file today nor in his own words (a teaser stays vague: never what, when or how much)
an app screen his words do not ask for (the brief lists the ones they do: request.json freeScreens)
the navigator or the OBD scanner, their voices, adapters or screens while they are locked
"free" for a VINARI+ feature
a user count or a percentage about the app, or a number of our own
a store, a download, Android, Google Play or a link, even when his idea asks for it (the closest line without it, and say so after · not done:)
a street word his idea did not write (the free film adds none of its own)

categories.label: მანქანის ცოდნა
categories.tier: general car knowledge, true and useful, as a 45 to 60 s LESSON (the hook, why it matters, how it works step by step with a picture each, one everyday example, the takeaway, in one connected voice); the app only when a fact the film uses links a feature, and then that feature's own tier, facts and never-list
facts: The facts are the bank in ci/carinfo-sources.json "lines": one "<id>: <plain Georgian>" line each (545 facts in 25 themes; 194 of them practical tips, "tip": true), kept out of this file so it stays short. The brief offers a few themes per film; for a fact it lacks, Grep that file for the topic's words (never read it whole) and use only its lines.
never: a fact, number, year, name or rule that is not in the bank (the offered facts, or a bank line his idea needs; no invented figure, no "studies show", no "most drivers")
a UK, US, Canadian, Australian, German, EU or Japanese rule (any foreign rule, or a club's or a maker's advice) said as Georgian law: say whose rule it is
Resolution No. 80 (methane, CNG) rules said about LPG, or the app's „LPG ბალონი“ date called a methane date

a fault named over a recording whose author did not name it (real-rough-idle, real-suspension-creak, real-squeak-pass and real-whine are only "something is wrong"; real-belt-squeak is a belt squeaking, its cause unknown), a sound whose author called nothing faulty (a turbo whistle, the steering pump, the valve train, the alternator) played as a fault, or a brake squeal recording (real-brake-squeal, real-brake-squeak: the common squeal while braking) played as the pad wear indicator
the app, its name or a screen when no fact the film uses links a feature (then it is a film without the app)
advice that is dangerous or illegal: dodging inspection, a fine, the police or a camera; driving on with a warning, a worn tyre or a failing brake
a repair price or time, a brand, a mechanic or a seller put down
„ხოდოვოი“ (say „სავალი ნაწილი“)
a drawn car where the car is not the point: draw the part (a clear diagram), use a real photo or a real screen

a feature that is not in these facts

categories.label: აპში დაემატა
categories.tier: the newest update: what is free and what is VINARI+ is said with each item
facts: An announcement film about the newest update: one new thing shown well, or two or three in one everyday story. Each item keeps its own category's facts and never-list too (widgets, engine, vin, reminders, in the categories file the brief names).

Home screen widgets, free: the nearest date with the days left ("ტექინსპექტირება 53 დღე"), your car card (the plate, the market price and its change, the next date), the garage (up to three cars and where you parked), a month calendar, and the lock screen. They never go online, and they show what your plan shows (more cars, calendar entries and the parked spot are VINARI+).

Trouble codes explained in Georgian, free and without internet: type the code a scanner or a mechanic gave you, like P0420, and see what it means, how urgent it is and which mechanic you need. 9 533 codes. The app does not plug into the car.
Japanese home-market cars: a frame (chassis) number like GRX130-6012345 is accepted where there is no VIN.
Your own car's two dates, the inspection and the LPG cylinder, and their reminders: now free to set and change. The calendar grid stays VINARI+.
Reading a VIN works without internet: the database is built into the app.
Garage: swipe a car to the left to edit or delete it.
A shorter first start, and more settings: the reminder time, the evening repeat, vibration apart from the sounds, the main car, your fuel, and a data export.
When a new version is out, a calm bar in the app says so.

VINARI+ is now monthly or yearly: $9.99 a month (about 26.99 ₾) or $49.99 a year (about 130.99 ₾; the lari figure is an estimate at today's rate, the charge is in dollars), and the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial. The screen compares: one month is about 7 liters of petrol at today's price, the whole year about one tank.
never: a feature, a plan or a date that is not in these facts
a version number in the voice or on screen
"free" for a VINARI+ feature
the price as the hook, the closing line or a sales pitch (at most once, calmly, as a fact)
telling the viewer to update, download or buy (no call to action: say what is new, not what to do)

categories.label: QR ბარათი
facts: A windshield card you print yourself: the app makes it, you print it on an ordinary A4 sheet in black and white (at home, at work or at any print shop), vertical or horizontal (the app's own switch on 08-qr-card: „ვერტიკალური“ / „ჰორიზონტალური“), cut it on the dashed line and put it behind the windshield, from the inside („ამოჭერი წყვეტილ ხაზზე და დადე საჭესთან, შიგნიდან.“). It can also be saved as a picture. Nothing is sold or shipped: no printer, no sticker, no ready card (people think we sell a QR printer: say plainly that you print it yourself on A4).

A passer-by scans it with the phone's camera, no app needed: a page opens (15-qr-web) and he taps one of three reasons, word for word: "მანქანა გზას მიკეტავს", "შუქები ანთია", "მანქანასთან რაღაც ხდება". He cannot type anything else. The owner gets a push at once.

No plate, no name and no car on the card. The owner's phone number is printed on it ONLY if the owner types it in the card's settings („პარამეტრები“ on 08-qr-card, which reads „ნომრის გარეშე“ until then); then it is printed openly under the code as „ან დარეკეთ“. Left empty, nobody sees a number, and the passer-by's number never reaches the owner either.

Why it matters (the owner, 2026-10-12): a girl who leaves her number on the glass gets calls and messages from strangers who took it off the windshield; with the card nobody sees her number, and a driver her car is blocking still reaches her. Just as good for a guy who does not want his number on show. Say it plainly, as privacy.
Quiet hours are optional and off by default; switched on, 23:00 to 07:00 unless changed, and a message then still arrives, silently.
Muted for 1, 8 or 24 hours if you like; at most 3, 8 or 20 messages a day (8 unless you change it).
Revoked with one confirmation: the printed card stops working for good („ეს ბარათი გაუქმებულია და აღარ მუშაობს.“), and a new code is a new print.

08-qr-card, measured (fractions of the 1080×2346 capture): the card preview y 0.15 to 0.35, the „ჰორიზონტალური“ / „ვერტიკალური“ switch y 0.37 to 0.41, „პარამეტრები · ნომრის გარეშე“ y 0.565 to 0.625, „ამობეჭდვა და გაზიარება“ y 0.65 to 0.70: push in and highlight the row the voice talks about.
explain: you print it yourself on an ordinary A4 sheet, vertical or horizontal, and put it behind the windshield from the inside: nothing to buy, no printer, no sticker
your phone number is on it only if you type it in the card's settings; leave it empty and nobody sees a number, yet a driver your car is blocking still reaches you
who it is for: a girl who does not want strangers calling or texting the number off her windshield, and any guy who does not want his number on show
never: "quiet at night" as if always on (quiet hours are off until switched on)
a promise that the owner comes (that is up to them)
a printer, a sticker, a ready card, delivery or a shop we sell (you print it yourself on A4)
the plate, a name or the car on the card, or a phone number on it that the owner did not type
a girl shown as weak, scared or a target, or anyone mocked: the point is privacy, said plainly

categories.label: დიაგნოსტიკა
categories.tier: the trouble-code lookup FREE, the sound check and the three questions VINARI+
facts: VINARI+ („ხმა და სიმპტომები“): you record the running engine on the phone, 8 to 10 seconds is enough (12-diagnostics-sound: „დაქოქე ძრავა, 8-10 წამი კმარა“; it takes at least 3 s and stops by itself at 12 s), or pick a video where the sound is heard. It says what KIND of noise it is: knock (კაკუნი), squeal (ჭრიალი), grinding (ღრჭიალი) or hum (გუგუნი), with how clear the sound was; or, honestly, that it could not tell (too short, too quiet, wind, talking ...: „სჯობს პირდაპირ გითხრა, რომ ვერ გავარკვიე, ვიდრე რამე მოგიგონო.“). The Wave scene draws three chips: pick three of the four (`labels`).
The sound is worked out on the phone and the recording is deleted right after: it goes nowhere.

VINARI+: three questions (when it happens, what you hear, where it comes from: 11-diagnostics-start asks „როდის გაწუხებს მანქანა?“) tell you which of 11 mechanic types you need, in drivers' words (კარობკა, ჟესტიანშიკი, მალიარი ...), how urgent it is (four steps), the likely causes ranked as a guess („ზუსტ მიზეზს მხოლოდ ხელოსანი დაადგენს“) and a ready sentence for the mechanic („რა უთხრა ხელოსანს“). The suspension mechanic is „სავალი ნაწილის ხელოსანი“ in a film (the older 13-diagnosis capture shows the Russianism the owner bans: crop it out or keep it out of the frame, and a film never says or writes it).
The sound check never names a part and never gives a diagnosis: the percentage is how clear the sound was, not how sure a diagnosis is („რას ვისმენ, გეტყვი. რა გატყდა, ვერ გეტყვი.“).

Free, and without internet: trouble codes (OBD-II) explained in Georgian. Type the code a scanner or a mechanic gave you, like P0420, and see what it means, how urgent it is and which mechanic you need.
9 533 codes. A code typed any way is found: P0420, p0420, 0420, or with a Georgian or Russian letter (პ0420, Р0420).
An example, word for word: P0420 is "კატალიზატორის ეფექტიანობა დაბალია"; the card says the car usually drives normally, but the inspection may be a problem.
Urgency has four steps: სასწრაფოდ, ერთ კვირაში, ორ კვირაში, კომფორტი.
The app does not plug into the car: you type the code, it explains it.
never: „ხოდოვოი“ in the voice, a subtitle or a drawn label (say „სავალი ნაწილი“)
"დიაგნოზი" or any medical word as the app's claim
a part named from a sound (a code's own title may name what it is about)
calling the sound check or the mechanic questions free
the app reading the code from the car
a repair price or time, or a code's urgency or mechanic that these facts do not give

facts: VINARI+ („ხმა და სიმპტომები“): you record the running engine on the phone, 8 to 10 seconds is enough (12-diagnostics-sound: „დაქოქე ძრავა, 8-10 წამი კმარა“; it takes at least 3 s and stops by itself at 12 s), or pick a video where the sound is heard. It says what KIND of noise it is: knock (კაკუნი), squeal (ჭრიალი), grinding (ღრჭიალი) or hum (გუგუნი), with how clear the sound was; or, honestly, that it could not tell (too short, too quiet, wind, talking ...: „სჯობს პირდაპირ გითხრა, რომ ვერ გავარკვიე, ვიდრე რამე მოგიგონო.“). The Wave scene draws three chips: pick three of the four (`labels`).
The sound is worked out on the phone and the recording is deleted right after: it goes nowhere.

VINARI+: three questions (when it happens, what you hear, where it comes from: 11-diagnostics-start asks „როდის გაწუხებს მანქანა?“) tell you which of 11 mechanic types you need, in drivers' words (კარობკა, ჟესტიანშიკი, მალიარი ...), how urgent it is (four steps), the likely causes ranked as a guess („ზუსტ მიზეზს მხოლოდ ხელოსანი დაადგენს“) and a ready sentence for the mechanic („რა უთხრა ხელოსანს“). The suspension mechanic is „სავალი ნაწილის ხელოსანი“ in a film (the older 13-diagnosis capture shows the Russianism the owner bans: crop it out or keep it out of the frame, and a film never says or writes it).
The sound check never names a part and never gives a diagnosis: the percentage is how clear the sound was, not how sure a diagnosis is („რას ვისმენ, გეტყვი. რა გატყდა, ვერ გეტყვი.“).

Free, and without internet: trouble codes (OBD-II) explained in Georgian. Type the code a scanner or a mechanic gave you, like P0420, and see what it means, how urgent it is and which mechanic you need.
9 533 codes. A code typed any way is found: P0420, p0420, 0420, or with a Georgian or Russian letter (პ0420, Р0420).
An example, word for word: P0420 is "კატალიზატორის ეფექტიანობა დაბალია"; the card says the car usually drives normally, but the inspection may be a problem.
Urgency has four steps: სასწრაფოდ, ერთ კვირაში, ორ კვირაში, კომფორტი.

Typing a code is free and needs no adapter. Reading the car itself (an adapter in its OBD-II port) is the OBD scanner, VINARI+, a category of its own: a diagnostics film shows where it is and may show its result once (22-obd-result: „შეგიძლია იარო?“ answered for the scanned car, engine and emissions only, a mechanic has the final word), never the adapter or live data.

Everything sits in one place since 1.0.4, the დიაგნოსტიკა screen (21-obd-hub): the black „OBD სკანერი“ card on top (VINARI+: „სკანირება“, „ყიდვამდე შემოწმება“), and under it „კოდი ხელით ჩაწერე“ (free, no internet) and „ხმა და სიმპტომები“ (the three questions and the engine sound, VINARI+). Measured (fractions of the 1080×2346 capture): the OBD card y 0.16 to 0.565, „კოდი ხელით ჩაწერე“ y 0.595 to 0.66, „ხმა და სიმპტომები“ y 0.665 to 0.74. 12-diagnostics-sound: the microphone y 0.31 to 0.40, „ჩაწერე მანქანის ხმა · 8-10 წამი კმარა“ y 0.41 to 0.46, the waveform y 0.48 to 0.51.

The owner's own story for the sound check's angle (2026-10-12): a friend's father spent 4 000 ₾ going from mechanic to mechanic just to find out what a noise in his car was. Tell it as that one story someone told (a friend's father), never as a typical cost, a statistic or a repair price; then what the app does instead: 8 to 10 seconds of the engine, the kind of noise, and with three questions the mechanic to go to first. Next to it, once and calmly, the price: VINARI+ is $9.99 a month on iPhone, charged in dollars („თვეში ათ დოლარზე ნაკლები“), or $49.99 a year with a 7-day free trial.

categories.label: OBD სკანერი
categories.tier: VINARI+ (a sample scan is free; typing a code stays free under დიაგნოსტიკა)
facts: Plug an ELM327 adapter into the car's OBD-II port: the app reads the check engine light, the trouble codes, the VIN, the battery and the readiness, then answers „შეგიძლია იარო?“ in plain Georgian.

On iPhone the adapter must be Wi-Fi or Bluetooth LE; a Classic Bluetooth adapter (PIN 1234) or a cable does not work there. On Android Bluetooth (Classic too), Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi adapters work; a cable does not.
It reads the engine and the emissions only, not ABS, the airbags or the body: a mechanic has the final word.
Also live data, a scan history, sending the codes and the verdict to a mechanic as text („ხელოსანს გაუგზავნე“), and clearing codes: the light goes out, but if the cause stays, the code comes back.

The pre-purchase check („ყიდვამდე შემოწმება“), with the same adapter: were the codes cleared recently (a battery change leaves the same trace, and the screen says so), permanent codes that clearing cannot remove, does the engine unit's VIN match the papers, and that VIN's auction record.
Inspection readiness: when every monitor has finished, the screen says „ტექინსპექტირებისთვის მზადაა“.

It lives inside დიაგნოსტიკა (21-obd-hub): the black „OBD სკანერი“ card on top, with „სკანირება“ and „ყიდვამდე შემოწმება“, and under it „კოდი ხელით ჩაწერე“ (free) and „ხმა და სიმპტომები“ (VINARI+). Measured (fractions of the 1080×2346 capture): the OBD card y 0.16 to 0.565, its „სკანირება“ button y 0.38 to 0.435.

The socket is under the steering wheel at knee height. A scan needs no internet (the adapter's Wi-Fi has none: the car's name and the codes' Georgian come from the phone); only the auction record of the pre-purchase check needs internet.

The result (22-obd-result) opens with „შეგიძლია იარო?“ and one of three answers, each with one reason and the code that decided it: „კი, შეგიძლია იარო“, „იარე, მაგრამ მალე ხელოსანთან“ or „გაჩერდი, როცა უსაფრთხოდ შეძლებ“. The capture shows „იარე, მაგრამ მალე ხელოსანთან“ for a misfire (P0300), the question „ჩეკი ციმციმებს?“, a Honda Accord 2015 with its VIN and „ჩეკის ნათურა · ანთია · 1 კოდი“ (measured: the verdict card y 0.16 to 0.57, the car y 0.595 to 0.745). An unknown code is never „იარე“.
Without VINARI+ a sample scan shows what a scan looks like.

categories.label: ნავიგატორი
categories.tier: VINARI+ (both voices to hear and one demo drive are free)
facts: A navigator that speaks Georgian, on iPhone and Android: Nelson (ნელსონი, calm and a little funny) or Alice (ალისა, warm and caring) tells you the way in Georgian, whatever the app's language.

It needs no internet at all: the map of Georgia, the search, the route, a new route when you miss a turn, and the voice are all on the phone (no separate map download), so it guides you in the mountains and with no signal. Georgia's roads only.

CarPlay is coming (the owner, 2026-10-12: "a promise, and we keep it"): the navigator will also show on the car's own screen with CarPlay. Say it only as a promise, „მალე CarPlay-ზეც“ (a small „მალე“ tag on a car screen), never as working today. What works today: the voice already plays through the car's speakers over Bluetooth or CarPlay audio. So a navigator film says all three: no internet needed, on the phone, and soon on the car's screen.

It talks like a person: first „სამას მეტრში მარჯვნივ მოუხვიე.“, then at the turn „ახლა მარჯვნივ მოუხვიე.“; on a roundabout it counts the exits („წრეზე მეორე გასასვლელით გადი.“); at a fork it says the side or the lane; it says when to go onto a bridge or under it; speed cameras ahead (OpenStreetMap data, may be incomplete: road signs come first) and the speed limit where the map knows it; before a long tunnel that the signal may drop; in the cold months that the pass ahead may be icy. Street names are an optional download („შოთა რუსთაველის გამზირზე.“).

Many settings of its own (20-nav-streets-settings, „პარამეტრები“), each a switch: „გრუნტის გზების გარეშე“ (keeps you off unpaved roads), „ჯიპი მყავს“ (with a 4x4 it may take jeep roads too), „იუმორი“ (now and then a joke, never at a turn; on by default, one switch turns it off), „ნელსონის ამბები“ / „ალისას ამბები“ (on a long road the voice tells a story of its own, each one once), „ციტატები“ (one warm line on a long quiet stretch), „მხოლოდ მთავარი“ (turns, safety and cameras only), „ქუჩების სახელები“; and how much it talks (ყველაფერი, მოსახვევები, ჩუმად), the camera alerts and the speed limit.

20-nav-streets-settings, measured (fractions of the 1080×2346 capture): „მხოლოდ მთავარი“ y 0.26 to 0.34, „ქუჩების სახელები“ y 0.35 to 0.47, „იუმორი“ y 0.48 to 0.57, „ნელსონის ამბები“ y 0.58 to 0.66, „ციტატები“ y 0.66 to 0.75, „გრუნტის გზების გარეშე“ y 0.84 to 0.90, „ჯიპი მყავს“ y 0.90 to 0.965: push in and highlight the switch the voice talks about.
With the screen locked the voice keeps guiding; the next turn shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
Home, work or „დედასთან“ starts with one tap and a 4-second countdown, also from the app icon or the widget.
Arrival times include the usual traffic for that hour and are corrected on the way; there is no live traffic.
It has its own tab in the bottom bar: მთავარი, კალენდარი, პარკინგი, ნავიგატორი. Home asks „სად მივდივართ?“.

categories.label: კალენდარი
categories.tier: the car's own two dates and their reminders FREE, the calendar VINARI+
facts: Every car has two dates of its own: the inspection (ტექინსპექტირება) and the LPG cylinder (LPG ბალონი). Setting and changing them, and their reminders, are free.

The calendar is VINARI+: every date on one month grid, with your own entries. Its types: oil (ზეთი), inspection (ტექინსპექტირება), tyres (საბურავები), the mechanic (ხელოსანი), insurance (დაზღვევა), parking (პარკინგი), the LPG cylinder (LPG ბალონი), the driving licence (მართვის მოწმობა), or anything in your own words.

Adding one: in the calendar you pick what to do ("რა უნდა გააკეთო": e.g. ხელოსანი), write it in your own words if you like (e.g. "საბურავების შეცვლა გიორგისთან"), pick the date and tap "მზადაა"; the reminder then comes on its own.
It reminds 7, 3 or 1 days before: you choose.
The morning reminder comes at 09:00 unless you move it (06:00 to 12:00, in settings) and on every step; the 19:30 evening repeat comes only 1 day before and on the day, and can be switched off.
Local: scheduled on the phone, no server.
The free home screen widget counts the days to the nearest date, e.g. "ტექინსპექტირება 53 დღე".

categories.tier: FREE (a widget shows what your plan shows)
facts: Home screen widgets, free for everyone. A widget never goes online: it shows what the app already knows, and a tap opens that place in the app.
Small, "ვადა": the nearest date and the days left, e.g. "ტექინსპექტირება 53 დღე". The same on the lock screen: a ring, a short line or one line of text.
Medium, "მანქანა": your car card: the plate, the market price with its change, and the next date.
Large, "გარაჟი": up to three cars with their prices and dates, and where you parked.
Calendar, medium or large: this month as a grid, today ringed, the days with a date marked, and the next dates beside it or under it.
On the free plan a widget shows one car and its own two dates (the inspection and the LPG cylinder); more cars, your calendar entries and the parked spot come with VINARI+.
The look is the app's: white cards, black ink, clean and calm.
